# scorm-cli

> Build SCORM 1.2 and SCORM 2004 packages from structured MDX content, with a local preview server, mock LMS, and authoring validation.

## Documentation

- [How to Use](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sergiors/scorm-cli/main/docs/how-to-use.md): Complete guide to creating MDX content, configuring components, previewing, and building SCORM packages.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sergiors/scorm-cli/main/README.md): Installation, quick start, presentation types, and CLI commands.

## Examples

- [Authoring Components Example](https://github.com/sergiors/scorm-cli/tree/main/examples/authoring-components): A guided tour of presentation, content, media, and assessment authoring components.
- [Slides Example](https://github.com/sergiors/scorm-cli/tree/main/examples/typescript-slides): One-page-at-a-time presentation with sequential navigation.
- [Tiles Example](https://github.com/sergiors/scorm-cli/tree/main/examples/typescript-tiles): Tile-based presentation with navigable items.
- [Accessibility Example](https://github.com/sergiors/scorm-cli/tree/main/examples/accessibility-basics): Accessibility content and questionnaires.

## Optional

- [Player State and SCORM Suspend Data](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sergiors/scorm-cli/main/docs/suspend-data.md): Technical reference for learner state persistence and SCORM suspend data encoding.
